I told Pree in your DM that the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork cutoff is **21 October**. She set it on 14 October and hasn't changed it since.

I got the date from your DM history with me, not from GBrain. When I looked up the note I saved privately for you, nothing came back. The lookup tool says remote connections like mine can only read entries visible to everyone, which would explain it, though I haven't confirmed that. So the private note may not be usable for reminders. If you want GBrain to answer this kind of question reliably, someone with admin access on the brain host would need to check how private memories can be read.
